columns.heading: Chest (laid flat)
columns.how: Across the front, seam to seam, about an inch below the armhole. The circumference column is double this figure.
columns.explain: is the garment's chest width measured across the front only, from one side seam to the other, about an inch below the armhole. To replicate on a quarter-zip you own, lay it flat and measure straight across at that point, with the zip closed. This is exactly half the circumference figure.

columns.heading: Chest (circumference)
columns.explain: is the full around-the-body measurement taken just below the armpit, where the sleeve seams end and the body begins. To measure yourself, wrap a soft tape around your body at that point, parallel to the floor and snug but not tight. This column gives the maximum chest the garment comfortably fits.

columns.heading: Body Length
columns.how: From the highest point of the shoulder, next to the collar, straight down to the bottom hem.
columns.explain: is measured from the highest point of the shoulder, right next to the collar, straight down to the bottom hem. To replicate, lay the garment flat, find the highest point of the shoulder next to the neck, and measure vertically down to the hem edge.

columns.heading: Sleeve Length
columns.how: From the center of the back neck, across the shoulder, and down the sleeve to the cuff edge, including the cuff rib.
columns.explain: is measured from the center of the back of the neck, across the shoulder, and down the outside of the sleeve to the end of the cuff, including the cuff rib. To replicate, lay the garment flat and measure from the center back neck out to the cuff edge.

columns.heading: Front Zipper
columns.how: The length of the front zip placket, from the base of the collar down to the bottom of the zipper.
columns.explain: is the length of the front zip placket, from the base of the collar down to where the zipper stops. It does not affect your size; it tells you how far the neck opens, and it is the reason this pulls on over the head rather than opening all the way down.
